Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

AWS RDS instance deletion: how to stop it

What happens

AWS RDS instance deletion. The call below tries to delete cloud resources. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves AWS.

The call

aws rds delete-db-instance --db-instance-identifier prod-db --skip-final-snapshot

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Turn on deletion protection for the instance with aws rds modify-db-instance --db-instance-identifier NAME --deletion-protection (for Aurora, modify the cluster), so a delete fails until a person turns it off. Give the agent an IAM role that allows neither rds:DeleteDBInstance nor rds:ModifyDBInstance, which can turn the protection off, and keep manual snapshots, which RDS does not delete with the instance.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule cloud-delete, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
